answer: The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in ledge, expire in lantern, and pearl lists each expiry. Someone running 34 aliases thus needs 110 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1203 identities would post 2347 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
